WITH year_total_s AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN 
        store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year IN (1998, 1999)
        AND sale_type = 's'
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id
    HAVING 
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) > 0
),
year_total_w AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN 
        web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year IN (1998, 1999)
        AND sale_type = 'w'
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id
    HAVING 
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0
),
t_s_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        year_total / LAG(year_total) OVER (ORDER BY customer_id) ratio_1998_1999
    FROM 
        year_total_s
),
t_w_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        year_total / LAG(year_total) OVER (ORDER BY customer_id) ratio_1998_1999
    FROM 
        year_total_w
)
SELECT 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM 
    t_s_ratio t_s_firstyear
JOIN 
    t_s_ratio t_s_secyear ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN 
    t_w_ratio t_w_firstyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN 
    t_w_ratio t_w_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
WHERE 
    t_s_firstyear.ratio_1998_1999 > t_w_firstyear.ratio_1998_1999
ORDER BY 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
